licence: repo root LICENSE.txt is Business Source License 1.1; templates/chat-react-ts/LICENSE and templates/chat-console-rs/LICENSE are Apache 2.0; conflict unresolved, treated as restricted
best_idea: Take the author and the server time from the server's call context, never from the client, and keep presence as one online flag on the account row set by connect and disconnect hooks.
decision_why: Server-verified authorship is Frankendom's rule and this module shows it in a few lines; the donor has no session count, so one closed tab would mark a player offline, and the licence is restricted, so only the shape transfers.
acceptance: Server test: an account with two open sockets stays online after one closes and goes offline only when the last closes; a chat line carries the server's author id and server time whatever the client sent.
